The **TMC** alleges that the attack was orchestrated by **BJP** supporters, citing the presence of a local **BJP** functionary at the scene. The **BJP**, meanwhile, claims internal factionalism within the **TMC** may be responsible for the incident.  At least five people have been arrested in connection with the attack and are being held pending court appearance.

recent_articles.title: Hundreds arrested and dozens of police injured after Champions League riots in France
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Hundreds** of people were arrested and dozens of **police officers** injured in clashes between football fans and police following Paris Saint-Germain's (PSG) victory in the Champions League final. The violence disrupted public transportation services in Paris, with thousands of officers deployed to maintain order.  The interior minister stated that security forces would be "firm" in their response to prevent further unrest. **Marine Le Pen**, leader of the far-right party, criticized the events, stating that they are unique to France.
